message.content:
According to section 5.1 only, the translation language pairs and corresponding reported training-set sizes are:

- **English-to-German**: 4.5 million sentence pairs
- **English-to-French**: 36M sentences

Source character spans:
- English-to-German: “trained on the standard WMT 2014 English-German dataset consisting of about 4.5 million sentence pairs”
- English-to-French: “we used the significantly larger WMT 2014 English-French dataset consisting of 36M sentences”
